name: Research Methods for Public Policy
description: The objective of this course is to introduce the foundational elements of research, such as the paradigm of inquiry, research questions, variables of interest and sample of respondents, to students. The course begins with an exploration of what is knowledge and research, why (academic) research is important, and how they relate to various aspects of the society. It provides an understanding of various types of research - basic and applied; quantitative and qualitative - and introduces students to the various methods and methodologies of doing research. It delves into the role of theory in research, how research contributes to knowledge building, practice and creates impact in the society.
